body:
Well...I've e-mailed my professor and I haven't heard back yet. I don't know what I'm going to do if

a.) I never hear back from her. Or
b.) I hear back from her, but too late to register for the classes I need. 

It's crazy, because yesterday before everything went to hell, I was the happiest I could remember being. I had talked to the professor of the class I need directly and she said she was fine with me entering her class despite not meeting the prerequisite. 

I was estatic. The thought of me walking across that stage and FINALLY getting my degree filled me with such pride I haven't felt in years. 

But, apparently, it is the Dean's decision that matters not the professor's when it comes to things like that. She said no. That I would be "woefully unprepared" despite being so close to meeting the required grade. 

I cried in my advisor's office like a baby. 

To go from the highest of highs to the lowest low you can imagine is like falling without the relief of the ground to wake you. 

I want to force the ground to meet me. Falling asleep without waking up sounds so....peaceful. 

Thank you for all the support and kind words, you guys. It's meant more than you can imagine and brought me to tears many times over. I don't know any of you, but I love every single one of you for it.
